- Added a homepage field linking to the project repository in the skill metadata.
- No functionality or documentation changes beyond metadata update.

llm.summary: This skill is purpose-built to monitor local workflow behavior and share derived patterns with an external network, but its collection, transmission, install, and auto-publication controls are not scoped tightly enough for low-risk installation.

dimensions.detail: External networking defaults to a public HiveMQ Cloud broker with built-in credentials, and the collectors touch privacy-sensitive local activity sources; that is high-impact relative to the privacy guarantees because the implementation is not present to verify filtering, transport, retention, or payload limits.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The install metadata uses an unpinned global npm install for @humebio/hume-network, @humebio/collector-dev, and @humebio/collector-system, while the artifact contains only SKILL.md and not the package source, lockfile, or integrity data needed to verify the installed code.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions broadly tell the agent to observe the user's workflow, feed observations, propose patterns, and vote against local observations; review is normally required, but the documented auto-approve/auto-propose path can bypass per-pattern user review.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No cross-reboot service or privilege escalation is shown, but the skill documents a persistent node process, five-minute collector intervals, local keypair/database files, and optional automatic proposal of mined patterns during runtime.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The networked pattern-sharing purpose is coherent, and the skill repeatedly says to abstract data and avoid personal details, but the stated capabilities include observing developer workflow, file activity, git history, app switching, shell-history categories, and system state before sending derived observations to a public network.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with local behavioral telemetry being processed by third-party npm packages and shared as derived patterns with a public network. Keep collectors, mining, and auto-propose disabled unless you have reviewed the actual package source and destination settings, and avoid enabling shell-history or system collectors in sensitive work environments.
llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: The concern is supported in part: monitoring and external pattern sharing are core to the skill, and later sections disclose collectors and public-network defaults, but the front matter and activation examples understate the privacy impact of continuous local behavioral telemetry.
[EA2] unexpected: The auto-approve exception is a real review concern because outbound sharing of mined local behavior should retain explicit user review; auto-propose is documented as disabled by default, so this does not by itself show malicious behavior.
[T08] unexpected: The global unpinned npm install is a concrete supply-chain concern because the executable packages are not included in the artifact and future installs can resolve to different code.
[T05] expected: Local workflow collection is expected for this skill's stated function, but the breadth of git, file, shell-history, app, and system observations is sensitive and not independently verifiable from the artifact.
[other] expected: External transmission to a network is expected for Hume Network, but default public broker settings, built-in credentials, continuous collection, and optional automatic publication make the behavior under-scoped for a benign pass.
